title: Tailored on-surface fabrication of mesoporous metallic composites by direct pyrolysis of metal ion-accumulated micellar films for enhanced electrocatalytic water splitting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03765K, Paper
Jingchun Wang, Yan Sun, Yan Cui, Huibin Qiu
A micellar film system was employed to direct the formation of highly tailored mesoporous metallic composites on eletrode.
